newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Warren, N.J.

text.p: SUMMARY NOTICE OF SALE
The Board of Education of the Township of Warren
(County of Somerset)
New Jersey
School District Bonds
(Book-Entry Bonds)(Bank Qualified)(Non-Callable)
SEALED PROPOSALS will be received by the Board of
Education of the Township of Warren in the County of
Somerset, New Jersey (the Board''), at the Woodland
School, 114 Stirling Road, Warren, New Jersey, on
January 21, 1997,
until 11:00 A.M., at which time they will be publicly opened
and announced, for the purchase of the Board's school
district bonds dated January 15, 1997 and due January 15,
according to the following schedule (collectively, the
Bonds'') in accordance with the Notice of Sale dated
January 9, 1997 (the Notice of Sale''):
Individual purchases of beneficial ownership interests in
the Bonds will be made in book-entry form (without
certificates) in the denomination of $5,000 each or any
integral multiple thereof, except that such minimum amount
of the last maturing Bonds in excess of the largest
principal amount thereof equaling a multiple of $5,000 will
be in the denominations of $1,000, or any integral multiple
thereof, as may be necessary to comply with the proposal for
Bonds of the successful bidder to accept less than the full
amount of the Bonds offered for sale, in accordance with the
Notice of Sale.
The Bonds will bear interest at a single rate of interest
in a multiple of 1/8 or 1/20 of 1% per annum specified by
the successful bidder payable on July 15, 1997 and
semiannually thereafter on January 15 and July 15 in each
year until maturity. The Bonds will be sold to be bidder
specifying the lowest rate of interest in accordance with
the terms of the Notice of Sale.
The Bonds will be designated as
qualified tax-exem
obligations'' for purposes of Section 265(b)(3) of the
Internal Revenue Code of 1986, as amended.
Copies of the Preliminary Official Statement, the Notice
of Sale, the Proposal for Bonds and the form of the legal
opinion of Crummy, Del Deo, Dolan, Griffinger & Vecchione, a
Professional Corporation, Newark, New Jersey, bond counsel
to the Board, may be obtained from the Secretary of the
Board of Education at the Woodland School, 114 Stirling
Road, Warren, New Jersey 07059 (telephone (908) 647-0216).
Dated: January 9, 1997
Board Secretary
(From The Bond Buyer)
